title: Reconcile European title and opening inventories
platforms: European ROM; prior Windows via Wine
changes: Reconcile retained title-language, main-title and opening address inventories with E228 and record the existing ordinary five-choice title-selector Wine evidence.
validation: Static unit d83mbwp2 checks the exact EUR ROM and current source hashes; all 62, 8 and 8 previously unowned sample bytes respectively now have declared owners. The three samples contain 70 distinct bytes.

limitations: Declared source ownership does not prove current runtime dispatch, execution PCs, complete scene coverage or absence of another language-selection route.
Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending; no performance comparison was performed.
